shop/makes

What it is
  = Give a project its things.
  Version:
    title: 3
  After a restart:
    title: Taken up where it was
  Runs:
    title: On, for what it hears
  = Whoever applies it may tell it 2 things:
    = What the second thing is called. It has to be said. [name]
    = The kinds there are, each given a thing of its own. Unless it is said: `red` and `green`. [kinds]

What it makes
  `shop/watch` [uses/watcher]
    tags: attached
    named: `watcher`
    opens: blueprint shop/watch
    made: a blueprint `shop/watch` (shop/watch)
  Makes: [main/first]
    title: a thing called `shelf`
    made: a thing `shelf` (shelf)
  Makes: [main/second]
    title: a thing called what the param `name` says
    made: a thing the param `name`
  a thing called `bin-<the item>` [main/each]
    only: One for each of the param `kinds`.
    made: a thing `bin-<the item>`
  `shop/helper` [main/helper]
    tags: left running
    named: `helper`
    opens: blueprint shop/helper
    made: a blueprint `shop/helper` (shop/helper)
  the blueprint the param `name` names [main/counted]
    tags: waited for
    named: `count-<the param name>`
    made: a blueprint the blueprint the param `name` names
  a thing called `spare` [on.made/again]
    by: made
    made: a thing `spare` (spare)

What it does when it is applied
  The thing everything else is kept in. [main/first]
  Make sure a thing is there. [main/second]
  Make sure a thing is there. [main/each]
    only: Once for each of the param `kinds`.
  Read a thing. [main/read]
  Start `shop/helper` and go on. [main/helper]
  Run the blueprint the param `name` names and wait for it to finish. [main/counted]

What it hears, and what it then does
  `thing.made`: a thing was made [on.made/@]
    from: Heard from its own project, and from the factory itself.
    Make sure a thing is there. [on.made/again]

What it may do
  = It runs as whoever applies it, and can do no more than they can.
  Permissions:
    items: `things`
    items: `blueprints`
  = Read things. [things:read]
  = Make and change things. [things:write]
  = Start, apply and stop blueprint instances. [blueprints:run]
  = What the blueprints it starts may do is said of each of them: `shop/helper` and the blueprint the param `name` names.
